name: Camp N.O.W.
street_address: New Rochelle High School, 265 Clove Road
description_short: City Youth Bureau camp for pre-teens at New Rochelle High School, Monday to Thursday 10 to 3, with sports, active and quiet games, arts, STEAM and pre-teen themed activities, plus three Friday trips at extra cost.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Camp page: 2026 registration opened March 2; five hour camp Monday to Thursday 10 am to 3 pm with three Friday trips at an extra fee; a $125 program enrichment fee; New Rochelle High School, 265 Clove Road, New Rochelle, NY 10801; July 6 to August 13. A recent report card and immunization record are needed to register. No ages or grades given beyond 'pre-teen'.

source.title: New Rochelle Youth Bureau Camp N.O.W.
